stage1.impression: This reads as a dim CG home-cinema showroom, not a photograph of a bar. Two identical speakers sit in dead-black recesses on a wall that looks like square bathroom tile, and the foreground tub chairs are smeared, shapeless pinkish blobs with one blown arm beside a glowing orb. Denoiser smear softens every surface, the floor between the seats and the speakers is a void, and nothing in the frame shows anyone has been here. A magazine would take it for a generic hi-fi room, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The felt panels behind the speakers must read as felt with texture and tone (niche region lum_median 14 to 28), not as black voids (now 6 to 8)
The end-grain block lining must read as timber end grain with per-block variation in tone and growth rings, not as a uniform square tile grid with dark grout
The foreground tub chairs must read as espresso velvet with pile and sheen, with no clipping on the near chair (clip_pct < 0.5 in [0,380,140,480], now 5.34)
The floor and riser between the seats and the altar must carry a falloff pool, not a void (lum_median 16 to 30 in [120,340,720,400], now 11.7)
A full-resolution frame with no denoiser smear: chair fabric, speaker cabinet edges and the oak plinths crisp at 1:1
A sign of life in the near ground (a glass, a record sleeve or a coat) and a composition that shows a whole chair and table, not cropped backs
The smoked tint of the speaker cabinets should read as smoke, a grey-brown veil over the batts, at a glance

defects.what: Near chair arm blown out by the Orb (clip 5.34 %), smooth and pinkish-mauve (R97 G69 B65) rather than espresso velvet; no pile texture
Right foreground chair back is a large, featureless, smeared dark-mauve shape cutting across the bottom of the frame
Felt panel behind the left speaker reads as a black void (lum_median 8.2); the speaker floats with no depth cue
Felt panel behind the right speaker is likewise a black void (lum_median 6.3)
End-grain block lining reads as a uniform bathroom tile grid: regular squares, dark grout, little tone variation (lum_range 25.7)
Carpet and riser between the seats and the altar are a dead dark band (lum_median 11.7); no step edge or light pool
Vertical haze shaft from the altar spot reads as a smudge or streak on the lens
Second haze shaft, same smudge look
Speakers render as neutral grey and white (R61 G57 B60); the white batts dominate and the smoked cast acrylic barely reads
Denoiser smear on the cabinet and its reflections at proof scale; the edges and the reflections inside the acrylic are mushy
The Orb lamp is a soft featureless glowing ball; its tinted shell and frosted liner do not separate
Left timber pilaster is a smooth, evenly striped wood texture with no checks or end grain; it reads as veneer

changes.problem: The near Orb blows out the chair arm beside it and tints it mauve, so the most prominent object in the frame is a clipped blob.

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Orb W and glow

changes.expected: The chair arm holds texture and a warm gradient; the Orb becomes a small bright practical with a pool on the table top.

changes.problem: The felt behind each speaker gets no light, so the speakers float in black rectangles and the niche loses its depth.

change.setting: add a concealed grazer at each niche head (new lamp)
change.to: 2 x linear area, 12 W each, 2700 K, aimed down the felt and the end-grain returns

changes.expected: The felt reads as a soft textured dark-brown surface, brighter at the top and falling off toward the speaker, with the speaker's silhouette clear against it.

changes.problem: The end-grain block lining reads as square bathroom tile with dark grout.

evidence.measured: lum_median 25.1, lum_range 25.7: uniform squares, joints darker than the faces

change.setting: the oak's stain / end-grain block finish
change.from: a uniform tone per block, dark recessed joints
change.to: a ±15 % tone variation per block, visible growth rings and checks, tight joints close to the face tone, a slight relief between blocks

changes.expected: The wall reads as timber end-grain parquet at its real scale; the joint grid recedes.

changes.problem: The floor and the 200 mm riser between the seats and the altar are a dead band, so the zone's room-within-a-room reads as nothing.

change.setting: add a step light under the riser nosing (new lamp), and the altar spots' cone
change.from: no riser light; altar 2 x spot 220 W, cone 30 deg
change.to: a 2700 K linear strip at 4 W/m under the nosing; altar cone 30 to 38 deg so the spill reaches the plinth fronts and the carpet

changes.expected: A thin bright line marks the riser edge, with a soft pool on the carpet in front of the plinths.

changes.problem: Two cropped chair backs fill the bottom third as shapeless masses, and the frame reads as a home cinema seen from behind the sofa.

evidence.measured: bottom profile bins 48.9/75.6/70.3, dominated by out-of-focus chair backs

change.to: [11.4, 1.6, 1.05] to [16.4, 3.1, 0.95], 32 mm: shift right and back so one whole tub chair with its hex table, Orb and glass sits at the lower left third, the pair framed between it and the right wall

changes.expected: One complete chair and table in the near ground, the altar in clear view, specific furniture rather than anonymous backs.

changes.problem: Denoiser smear softens the chairs, the speaker cabinets and the acrylic reflections, which says render at once.

evidence.measured: the cabinet edges and reflections are mushy at 3x; the chair surfaces are plasticky smooth

change.setting: render samples, adaptive, frame scale; post grain
change.to: 512 samples, adaptive 0.01, full 2400 x 1600; add fine luminance grain (ISO 800 look) in post

changes.expected: The velvet pile, oak grain and cabinet edges are crisp at 1:1; the shadows carry grain, not smear.

changes.problem: There is no sign of life near the camera, so the room reads as a showroom.

evidence.measured: the hex table carries only the Orb; no glass, sleeve or coat in frame

change.to: a half-drunk rocks glass and a record sleeve on the near hex table; a coat or scarf over the near chair's arm

changes.expected: A lived-in near ground, with the glass catching a small highlight from the Orb.

changes.problem: The haze shafts from the altar spots read as vertical smudges on the lens at the top of the frame.

evidence.measured: two isolated pale vertical streaks at x about 175 and 585, top of frame

changes.expected: The haze softens the background evenly without reading as discrete streaks.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Smoke cabinets read darker and more tinted, so the white batts show less
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour and parts are fixed; only the altar spots' level and angle may change, and c2 and c4 rebalance them.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the square end-grain block grid behind the altar with limewash or board-formed concrete
out_of_scope.why: The niche lining is the room's design as the card fixes it; c3 changes only its finish.

out_of_scope.request: Shoot only one speaker, or stagger the pair, so the frame does not read as two copies of one model
out_of_scope.why: The listening pair on the altar is the room's design; the camera change in c5 can only reduce the symmetry.
